{
  "name": "effortless",
  "version": "1.35.36",
  "description": "Sets the reasoning effort for every prompt automatically, shows it under the prompt box, and counts down how long the prompt cache stays warm.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "judge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Judge",
      "description": "Who picks the effort. auto: Jev when a TypeSafe key is set, else Haiku. haiku: your own Claude login, no key. jev: TypeSafe's Jev. custom: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint below.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "haiku",
        "jev",
        "custom"
      ]
    },
    "typesafeKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeSafe API key (optional, only for jev)",
      "description": "For the jev judge. Stored as a secret by Claude Code. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used, and with judge set to jev also ~/.config/jev/.env.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "customUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom judge URL (optional, only for custom)",
      "description": "An OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions or http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions",
      "default": ""
    },
    "customModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom judge model (optional, only for custom)",
      "description": "The model name the endpoint expects, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or llama3.2",
      "default": ""
    },
    "customKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom judge API key (optional, only for custom)",
      "description": "Sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty for a local model.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "handoffSkill": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Handoff skill (optional)",
      "description": "A skill or slash command for the Full handoff in the handoff bar, e.g. session-handoff. Quick is written by a fork with the built-in prompt. Leave empty for quick only.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "handoffAfter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After a handoff (first choice)",
      "description": "What the handoff bar starts on; it then remembers your last choice. continue: clear and carry on. confirm: clear, the new chat says where things stand and waits. copy: keep the chat and copy the handoff. newchat: a new chat starts from the handoff and this one is archived.",
      "default": "continue",
      "options": [
        "continue",
        "confirm",
        "copy",
        "newchat"
      ]
    },
    "effortBias": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Effort slider",
      "description": "-2 cheaper to 2 smarter. Tips the judge's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: as the judge says.",
      "default": "0",
      "options": [
        "-2",
        "-1",
        "0",
        "1",
        "2"
      ]
    },
    "effortFloor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Never below",
      "description": "Auto never picks a lower effort than this.",
      "default": "low",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "effortCeiling": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Never above",
      "description": "Auto never picks a higher effort than this.",
      "default": "max",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "hide": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Switched off",
      "description": "Comma-separated: handoff (the footer button), timer (the cache countdown), progress (the progress bar), sounds (its sounds). The alert bands always show. Empty shows everything.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "swampAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Swamped at",
      "description": "The swamp band shows once the context fills this percent of the window.",
      "default": "50",
      "options": [
        "10",
        "20",
        "30",
        "40",
        "50",
        "60",
        "70",
        "80"
      ]
    },
    "layout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Look",
      "description": "default: a dashboard band above the prompt (effort, Auto, cache, context, handoff). minimal: small buttons in the footer, no band.",
      "default": "default",
      "options": [
        "default",
        "minimal"
      ]
    }
  }
}
